comment: The rounding contract, asserted identically by internal/num (Go, authoritative), internal/js (the app runtime) and desk/src/lib/round.test.ts. One file, three readers: two copies of a table drift, and the day they drift is the day a form and the database disagree about a cent.

cases.why: the case everyone checks first: the stored double is 1.00499999999999989, but the reader typed 1.005
the asymmetry of the old roundTo: a credit and a debit of the same size have to cancel
a tie whose kept digit is odd rounds up under both rules
a tie whose kept digit is even is where the two rules part
just below the half: not a tie, and no rule may round it up
carry all the way into a new leading digit
whole units, as a JPY site rounds
three places, as a KWD site rounds
a large mantissa still ties on the discarded digits alone
a negative that rounds to zero must not come back as -0
below the last place, from either side
JS prints this one in exponent notation and Go does not; both must still leave it alone
beyond the point where a double spaces closer than the last place, the value is already exact
fewer fraction digits than asked for: untouched, not re-parsed
